meta.title: Resolving Editing-Unlearning Conflicts: A Knowledge Codebook Framework for Large Language Model Updating
meta.paper_type_explanation: The paper introduces LOKA, a novel framework for LLM knowledge updating that addresses editing-unlearning conflicts using a knowledge codebook with task-specific/multi-task memories, similarity-aware mapping, and a learning-based router.

A_data_and_task.domain_data_type_explanation: Focuses on QA pairs involving fictitious writers (TOFU), harmful content (PKU-SafeRLHF), and factual relations (ZsRE).
A_data_and_task.task_type_explanation: Addresses simultaneous unlearning of unwanted knowledge and editing of new knowledge while preserving retained knowledge.

dataset_size.documents: TOFU: 4,000 QA pairs; subsets ~400-800 samples per task

A_data_and_task.dataset_characteristics_explanation: TOFU has 4,000 QA pairs from 200 writers; PKU-SafeRLHF and ZsRE used with 400 samples each for unlearning/editing; no temporal data.
A_data_and_task.benchmark_metrics_explanation: ROUGE-L for editing/retained; truth ratio/MIA for unlearning; success rate/accuracy for remaining knowledge.

B_graph_kg_structure.graph_kg_representation_type_explanation: No explicit graph or KG; uses knowledge codebook with external memories (sparse/dense storage discussed but not graph-based).
B_graph_kg_structure.graph_evolution_type_explanation: Sequential updating adds new codebooks or uses LSH for incremental mapping without re-clustering.
B_graph_kg_structure.node_types_explanation: Knowledge stored in codebook memories, not nodes.
B_graph_kg_structure.edge_types_explanation: No edges; similarity-based clustering via K-means or LSH.
B_graph_kg_structure.graph_scale_explanation: Codebook size ~20 clusters; no node counts specified.

C_temporal_modeling_and_queries.temporal_structure_type_explanation: No temporal modeling; focuses on knowledge updating without time aspects.

D_dynamic_update_mechanisms.update_trigger_explanation: Sequential requests; each adds codebook or incremental via LSH.
D_dynamic_update_mechanisms.update_policy_control_logic_explanation: Conflict score (cosine similarity of gradients) decides task-specific vs multi-task memories.
D_dynamic_update_mechanisms.update_scope_explanation: Knowledge pieces (QA pairs) updated in external memories.

verification_pipeline.confidence_scoring_approach: Classifier confidence threshold for router activation

D_dynamic_update_mechanisms.verification_pipeline_explanation: BERT classifier for relevance; threshold filters irrelevant prompts.
D_dynamic_update_mechanisms.conflict_resolution_strategy_explanation: Task-specific memories for heavy conflicts; Pareto optimization (MGDA) for slight conflicts.
D_dynamic_update_mechanisms.incremental_construction_explanation: LSH for scalable incremental updates without re-clustering.

update_latency_throughput.scalability_characteristics: Efficient sequential updates; tradeoff with new codebooks

D_dynamic_update_mechanisms.update_latency_throughput_explanation: Lower latency with LSH vs new codebooks; A100 GPU used.

E_retrieval_and_reasoning.retrieval_unit_granularity_explanation: Retrieves relevant memory from codebook based on prompt embedding.
E_retrieval_and_reasoning.retrieval_strategy_explanation: K-means clustering for allocation; BERT classifier + threshold for activation; closest key selection.
E_retrieval_and_reasoning.retrieval_indexing_explanation: Embeddings from LLM layer fed to clustering; LSH for incremental.
E_retrieval_and_reasoning.reasoning_generation_protocol_explanatio: Retrieved memory plugged into target LLM layer (e.g., FFN) for inference.
E_retrieval_and_reasoning.context_window_management_explanation: Selective codebook activation avoids irrelevant memories.

F_llm_role_and_learning.llm_role_in_system_explanation: Original LLM frozen; external memories fine-tuned and plugged in.
F_llm_role_and_learning.llm_adaptation_mode_explanation: Fine-tunes external memories only; no LLM parameter updates.
F_llm_role_and_learning.llm_integration_pattern_explanation: Last-token embeddings for mapping; classifier (BERT) for routing.
F_llm_role_and_learning.continual_learning_support_explanation: Frozen LLM + external updates prevent forgetting; sequential handling.

G_evaluation_and_practical.evaluation_focus_explanation: Emphasizes joint editing/unlearning, preservation, sequential stability.
G_evaluation_and_practical.evaluation_metrics_explanation: LOKA achieves e.g., 0.8044 truth ratio (unlearning), 0.9599 ROUGE-L (editing) on TOFU.
G_evaluation_and_practical.baseline_comparisons_explanation: Outperforms baselines in joint tasks; addresses overfitting/underfitting.
G_evaluation_and_practical.graph_summarization_compression_explanat: Knowledge clustered in memories; no explicit graph summary.
G_evaluation_and_practical.scalability_analysis_explanation: Maintains performance over sequential updates; LSH trades utility for efficiency.
G_evaluation_and_practical.real_world_deployment_explanation: Discusses personalized updating, version control potential.

H_novel_technical_contributions.algorithmic_innovations_explanation: Theoretical proof of editing-unlearning conflicts when datasets similar (d_TV > threshold); task-specific memories guaranteed by Prop. 2.4.
H_novel_technical_contributions.architecture_patterns_explanation: Knowledge codebook with K-means/LSH; target layer replacement.
H_novel_technical_contributions.memory_storage_explanation: External FFN params from LLM layer; task-specific/multi-task.
H_novel_technical_contributions.neural_architecture_explanation: No GNNs; memory fusion via plug-in.

I_reproducibility_implementation.code_availability_explanation: Code to be released after acceptance.

key_hyperparameters: lr=1e-5 (unlearn), 1e-2 (edit); epochs=5-50; clusters=20; conf thr=70th percentile

scalability_limits: New codebooks inefficient for high-freq updates
generalization_issues: Paraphrased performance in some baselines; similar dist. hurts router

J_limitations_future_work.acknowledged_limitations_explanation: K-means not incremental; LSH trades utility; short-label unlearning easier.
J_limitations_future_work.future_research_directions_explanation: Flexible task objectives; distributed storage for versions.

K_cross_cutting_concerns.provenance_trust_explanation: Confidence via router; no explicit provenance.

main_findings: Sparse: overfitting; dense: underfitting; conflicts when d_TV small

notable_contributions_explanation: Introduces benchmark for joint updating; strong empirical gains (e.g., 0.85+ combined editing).

ambiguous_classifications: Graph aspects: N/A but codebook analogous to sparse graph
extraction_metadata.extraction_notes: Paper not on dynamic GraphRAG/temporal KG; focuses on LLM knowledge editing/unlearning via codebooks. Many fields N/A due to mismatch.
